infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cashbook uses the microphone so you can record wages and advances by speaking instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Cashbook uses Face ID to unlock your ledger so nobody else can read it if your phone is left unattended.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cashbook uses the camera so you can photograph the day's progress on site.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cashbook uses your photos so you can attach a material receipt to the site log.
